# culipulse_heartbeat_monitor (Resource)

A dead man's switch for cron jobs, backups and other scheduled work: your job calls `ping_url` when it finishes, and CuliPulse alerts when the call doesn't arrive on time. Heartbeat settings made in the console that this resource doesn't manage (such as a maximum run time) are reset on the next update.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "culipulse_heartbeat_monitor" "backup" {
  name             = "Nightly backup"
  interval_seconds = 86400
  grace_seconds    = 1800
}

# Give this to your job, e.g. `curl -fsS "$PING_URL"` as its last step.
output "backup_ping_url" {
  value     = culipulse_heartbeat_monitor.backup.ping_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interval_seconds` (Number) How often your job is expected to ping, in seconds.
- `name` (String) Name shown in the console and in alerts.

### Optional

- `down_after_failures` (Number) Missed pings in a row before the monitor is marked down (1–5). Default 2.
- `grace_seconds` (Number) Extra time allowed after the expected ping before it counts as missed. The default (20% of the interval, at least 60) applies when the monitor is created; removing this from your configuration afterward keeps the current value — set it explicitly to change it.
- `sla_target` (Number) Uptime goal in percent, e.g. 99.9. Used by SLA reports.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Monitor id.
- `ping_url` (String, Sensitive) The URL your job calls (GET, POST or HEAD) when it succeeds. Add `/fail` to report a failure, or `/start` when it begins. Anyone with this URL can report for the monitor, so treat it as a secret.
- `status` (String) Current state: `up`, `down`, `paused` or `pending`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import culipulse_heartbeat_monitor.backup mon_7a1d4e2f-8c3b-4a9d-b6e5-2f1c0d9a8b7c
```
